sources.detail: Three deposited structure records and one derived target preparation retained with evidence labels.
One prospective docked molecule, two docking controls, one designed binder, and one negative binder control.

limitations: This is a selected example and is not a complete target census or complete campaign archive.
Computational scores and structures are hypotheses; they do not establish binding, selectivity, safety, or efficacy.
Only selected completed result records and their direct supporting artifacts are included.
